overview_description.description: RefineTrain AI provides AI-powered invoice validation software focused on complex, contract-driven environments. The company offers an autonomous agentic AI system that ingests contracts, emails, and related documents to build a knowledge graph of vendor obligations and requirements. Its software cross-checks invoice line items against this knowledge and connected internal systems to detect overpayments, double payments, and non-compliant charges. High‑risk or uncertain invoices are flagged and accompanied by explanations and evidence to streamline human review instead of fully hands-off automation. The platform is designed to handle multi-step, interdependent checks across documents and systems without custom rule programming. RefineTrain AI targets legal, finance, and operations teams that manage intricate agreements, change orders, and high-value invoices.
